question: Which nation has the MOST doctors per person?

post.premise: A small island out-doctors every rich country
post.bait: It is not the United States.
keywords: which country has the most doctors
post.sources_line: World Bank World Development Indicators (physicians per 1,000); WHO Global Health Workforce Statistics; ONEI Cuba

youtube.title: Which country has the most doctors per person? Not the USA 🩺

Germany, the United States or the third one? The richest health systems on Earth are beaten, per head, by a country most people would never guess, and its doctors are now leaving by the tens of thousands.

threads.text: Which nation has the most doctors per person — Germany, the United States or Cuba? One of them trains physicians faster than it can keep them, posts them to dozens of other countries, and has watched the number at home shrink every year since the pandemic.

intent: The doctors-per-person misdirect: Germany has the hospitals and America the money, but a Caribbean island of 11 million trains more doctors per head than anyone — shown as three bars, undercut by a counter that falls as its doctors leave, and finished with the pin and the export nobody expects.

v04.text: Cuba. More than 9 doctors for every 1,000 people, the highest ratio on Earth.

v05.text: Germany has fewer than 5. The United States, for all its hospitals, has under 4.

v06.text: At its peak the island had over 100,000 doctors for 11 million people. Since then, tens of thousands have left.

v07.text: Cuba also sends doctors abroad: around 37,000 work in other countries, its main source of foreign income.

research.topic: Country with the most physicians per person: Cuba — about 9.5 physicians per 1,000 people (World Bank WDI / WHO, data year 2021), the highest in the world; Germany ≈ 4.5 (2022), United States ≈ 3.7 (2022). ONEI (Cuban statistics office) counts fell from 106,131 physicians in 2021 to 94,066 (2022), 80,763 (2023) and 75,364 (2024) on an island of ~11 million; about 37,000 Cuban doctors worked abroad in 2023 and medical services are Cuba's largest source of foreign income.

myths.myth: The United States, with the highest health spending, has the most doctors per person.
myths.reality: The United States has about 3.7 physicians per 1,000 people, Germany 4.5; Cuba has about 9.5, the highest ratio recorded.

landscape.our_gap: Doctor Shorts are salary rankings and med-school tips; nobody asks the per-person question on a map, shows the three bars, lets the island's count fall on screen and follows its doctors abroad.
